mapper.select: SELECT CASE role_key WHEN 'admin' THEN '管理员' WHEN 'dorm_manager' THEN '宿管' WHEN 'repair_worker' THEN '维修人员' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_user WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY role_key

SELECT CASE fault_type WHEN 1 THEN '水电' WHEN 2 THEN '门窗' WHEN 3 THEN '家具' WHEN 4 THEN '网络' WHEN 5 THEN '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM repair_order WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} AND audit_status = #{auditStatus} GROUP BY fault_type

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS value FROM repair_order WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name
SELECT CASE room_type WHEN 1 THEN '男生宿舍' WHEN 2 THEN '女生宿舍' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM dorm_building WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY room_type

SELECT CASE material_type WHEN 1 THEN '水电类' WHEN 2 THEN '门窗类' WHEN 3 THEN '家具类' WHEN 4 THEN '网络类' WHEN 5 THEN '其他' END AS name, SUM(stock_qty) AS value FROM material WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY material_type

SELECT CASE apply_status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '通过' WHEN 2 THEN '驳回' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM material_apply WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY apply_status
SELECT CONCAT(score, '分') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM repair_evaluate WHERE 1=1 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY score ORDER BY score
SELECT CASE notify_type WHEN 1 THEN '系统通知' WHEN 2 THEN '工单通知' WHEN 3 THEN '材料通知' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_notify WHERE 1=1 AND level = #{level} GROUP BY notify_type
SELECT CASE gender WHEN 0 THEN '未知' WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student_profile WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} GROUP BY gender

SELECT b.building_name AS name, COUNT(r.id) AS value FROM repair_order r LEFT JOIN dorm_building b ON r.building_id = b.id WHERE 1=1 AND r.create_time >= #{startTime} AND r.create_time <= #{endTime} AND r.order_status = #{orderStatus} GROUP BY b.building_name
